description: Dependency update policy for the FERAL MULE repository.
PROPOSALS ARE OPENED. NOTHING IS EVER AUTO-MERGED.
Kernel, out-of-tree radio driver, radio firmware and userspace promote as
ONE TESTED COMPATIBILITY SET, never independently (FML-ADR-040). A change
to any pin creates a new candidate set that must pass the full promotion
gate in os/release/README.md: rebuild all out-of-tree modules, boot,
enumerate every radio, form a mesh, serve the access point, pass a traffic
smoke test, survive a reboot, and demonstrate rollback.
A bot cannot make that decision, and a green CI run is not evidence that
the set still works, because CI has no radios. See test/README.md.

packageRules.description: Every update is a decision. No exceptions, including patch and security updates: a security update to one component of the compatibility set still requires re-qualifying the set. That cost is acknowledged in FML-ADR-040 rather than avoided by auto-merging.
Group repository tooling updates, which are not part of the compatibility set and can be reviewed together.
Container images are referenced by immutable digest, never by tag. Renovate proposes a digest bump; the reviewer decides whether the new artifact is promoted.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security advisories are labelled and raised, never merged automatically. See the compatibility set rule above.
